import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv", index_col=0)  # IdCausa, Causa
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv", index_col=0)  # IdDeteccion, Deteccion
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv", index_col=0)  # main large table
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv", index_col=0)  # IdActividad, Actividad
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv", index_col=0)  # IdFactor, Factor

# Join source2 (main fact table) with dimension tables on their respective keys:
# Join with source0 on 'Causa' (string key)
df = source2.merge(source0, on='Causa', how='left')

# Join with source1 on 'Deteccion' (string key)
df = df.merge(source1, on='Deteccion', how='left')

# Join with source3 on 'IdActividad' (integer key)
df = df.merge(source3, on='IdActividad', how='left')

# Join with source4 on 'IdFactor' (integer key)
df = df.merge(source4, on='IdFactor', how='left')

# After these joins, descriptive columns from source2 and dimension tables are duplicated.
# Keep descriptive columns from dimension tables and drop duplicates from source2.

cols_to_drop = []
for col in ['Causa', 'Deteccion', 'Actividad', 'Factor']:
    if col in df.columns and f"{col}_x" in df.columns and f"{col}_y" in df.columns:
        # Drop the _x version (from source2)
        cols_to_drop.append(f"{col}_x")
        # Rename _y version to original name
        df.rename(columns={f"{col}_y": col}, inplace=True)

df.drop(columns=cols_to_drop, inplace=True)

# Ensure the column order matches the target schema exactly:
target_columns = ['Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc',
                  'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion', 'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor',
                  'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion', 'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad',
                  'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion', 'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
                  'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
                  'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']

# Fix possible column name differences
if 'Dir. vi' in df.columns and 'Dir. vi.' not in df.columns:
    df.rename(columns={'Dir. vi': 'Dir. vi.'}, inplace=True)

# Add any missing columns with NaN
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.NA

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df = df[target_columns]

# Convert columns to appropriate types as per target schema

# 'Fecha': string
df['Fecha'] = df['Fecha'].astype(str)

# Integer columns (nullable Int64 to handle missing values)
int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'V_Viento', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']
for col in int_cols:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Float columns
float_cols = ['Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Edad', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
              'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']
for col in float_cols:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# String columns (fill NaN with empty string)
str_cols = ['Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 'Sexo', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion', 'Causa',
            'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion', 'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion',
            'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'Estacion', 'Estado']
for col in str_cols:
    df[col] = df[col].astype(str).fillna('')

# Save the final dataframe to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_critique_history.csv"
df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
